virtualization.blind_spot: a hypervisor that hides the CPUID bit and presents non-virtual DMI and drive identities

flush_sent_to_device: no: the (virtual) leaf reports write-through and its device report agrees, so the block layer sends it no flush; the host's own caching is unknown
floor_kind: no volatile cache (a virtual drive's report): no drive flush, host caching unknown
floor_claim: per stack: the cost of an fsync on a drive that receives no flush; neither 'one drive flush' nor 'above a same-batch drive flush' may be written; on a virtual drive: reach to media unknown
